author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission for Tides & Tales project £16,000
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth. Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production). EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026. Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.

author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs. The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing. You will be paid fair compensation. COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL!
